# FDI World Dental Federation

> Global representative organization for one million dentists worldwide, advancing oral health advocacy, professional standards, and dental practice excellence.

FDI World Dental Federation is an international membership organization headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, representing dental professionals across multiple countries. The federation coordinates global dental initiatives, sets professional standards, and advocates for optimal oral health through its governance structure, standing committees, and specialized working groups.

## Key Topics

- Oral health advocacy
- Global dental federation
- Vision 2030
- World Oral Health Day
- Governance structure
- General Assembly
- Council leadership
- Dental practice standards
- Professional membership
- Strategic planning
- Standing committees
- Working groups
- Dental education
- Organizational constitution
- International dental organization

## Organization Overview

- [FDI World Dental Federation](https://fdiworlddental.org): FDI World Dental Federation homepage showcasing global dental events and initiatives
- [About us](https://fdiworlddental.org/about-us): FDI organizational overview based in Geneva, Switzerland with mission details
- [Our purpose](https://fdiworlddental.org/our-purpose): FDI's mission to represent one million dentists and lead global oral health
- [Our strategy](https://fdiworlddental.org/our-strategy): FDI Strategic Plan 2024-2027 and Vision 2030 for optimal oral health

## Governance & Leadership

- [Governance](https://fdiworlddental.org/governance): FDI governance framework including General Assembly and Council structure
- [General Assembly](https://fdiworlddental.org/general-assembly): FDI General Assembly as supreme governing body with policies and awards
- [Council](https://fdiworlddental.org/council): FDI Council leadership members guiding organizational vision and mission
- [Constitution](https://fdiworlddental.org/constitution): FDI constitution defining organizational structure and core values
- [The team](https://fdiworlddental.org/the-team): FDI team directory and staff contacts at Geneva headquarters

## Committees & Organizational Structure

- [Council Committees](https://fdiworlddental.org/council-committees): FDI Executive, Finance, and Remuneration Committee structures
- [Standing Committees](https://fdiworlddental.org/standing-committees): FDI five Standing Committees covering practice, education, and membership
- [Reference Committees](https://fdiworlddental.org/reference-committees): FDI Reference Committees for budget and contentious matters discussion
- [Special Committees](https://fdiworlddental.org/special-committees): FDI Special Committees including Audit Committee for governance matters
- [Working Groups](https://fdiworlddental.org/working-groups): FDI Working Groups on advocacy, ethics, and policy implementation
- [Expert Groups](https://fdiworlddental.org/expert-groups): FDI Vision 2030 Implementation and Monitoring Expert Group

## Recognition & Specializations

- [Honorary members](https://fdiworlddental.org/honorary-members): FDI Dr Charles Godon Medal of Honour recognizing distinguished contributions
- [Section of Defense Forces Dental Services](https://fdiworlddental.org/section-defense-forces-dental-services): FDI Defense Forces Dental Services Section for military dentistry exchange

## Careers & Opportunities

- [Job opportunities](https://fdiworlddental.org/job-opportunities): Current job postings for FDI positions in Geneva and other locations
